title: I’m still processing. What did you think? #jonathanlarson #ticktickbo...
transcript: It’s a rainy day in Nashville and I just watched “Tick, Tick… Boom!“ on Netflix and oh my word what a beautiful stunning film one of my favorite musical movies is “all that jazz” and I feel that that movie in this movie have some similarities and parallels and terms of the fact that's about an artist whose life is cut short because of their heart an uncompromising artist who doesn't bow down to what popular opinion expects of them and even the ways how they integrate music into the storytelling but where “all that jazz” is sardonic wit told through a haze of cigarette smoke TTB is all love and it's a miracle this movie even got made — on the surface it could feel pretty niche it's actually universal story about wanting to belong wanting to be accepted feeling like you're running out of time but who doesn't feel like that especially as an artist wanting your voice to be heard. and then there's the cameos: I lost count. bernadette was it for me this is probably one of my favorite movie musicals if you haven't seen it yet you should see it
